method.scope: Every member decompressed to EOF with CRC32/SHA256 and every logical CSV record and field parsed; aggregate profiling and exact Decimal arithmetic.
method.parser: Python standard-library zipfile and csv, strict UTF-8; streaming SQL counters in disposable local SQLite, 5000-row batches and 16 MiB database page cache.
method.distinct_method: Exact SQLite keys for per-column strings and candidate key tuples. Row duplicate keys use full JSON-encoded field arrays (not row hashes), preserving field boundaries. Normalized rows trim field edges, canonicalize valid per-file dates (%d/%m/%Y or %Y-%m-%d) and Decimal RATE/QUANTITY/VALUE columns 12,13,14 (zero-based source positions); identifier/code spelling and case remain unchanged.
method.normalized_duplicate_limit: Normalization is diagnostic only; rows are not deleted or merged.
method.locator: One-based CSV logical record number including header; physical line boundaries also tracked. No raw investor, broker, transaction identifiers or security names included in public output.

cross_archive.scope: Pairwise exact 19-field rows, normalized rows and declared candidate key tuples across the four reviewed members only. Not compared to root Nov.2023.csv.

arithmetic_method.tolerances: Exact zero, absolute <=0.005 rupee and <=0.01 rupee are separate diagnostics. Precision-aware bound = abs(quantity) * 0.5 * 10^(-displayed RATE decimal places) + 0.5 * 10^(-displayed VALUE decimal places).
arithmetic_method.bound_assumptions: Tests compatibility with independently nearest-rounded rate and value and exact displayed quantity. Does not assert provider rounding policy, omitted charges, corporate-action treatment, correction semantics or transaction validity. Outside-bound rows remain unresolved source discrepancies, not automatically bad trades. Zero/signed values remain numeric evidence.
arithmetic_method.unit: VALUE header expressly says rupees; total reported values are unsigned-by-transaction-code arithmetic only, not inferred net institutional flow.

consumer_limits: Historical transaction reports only. Trade date and report/availability date must remain distinct; archive file name or ZIP timestamp is not market freshness or publication-time proof.

No transaction-code meaning, buy/sell direction, correction/cancellation rule, instrument taxonomy or custodian key contract is established by these raw columns alone. An authoritative matching-period dictionary is required before aggregation.

FII/SUB_ACC/BRKER tokens are not evidence of stable real-world identity across files, periods or roles. ISIN shape/checksum is not current exchange eligibility, corporate-action continuity or a verified Upstox join.

No open/high/low/close or exchange-wide volume bars, holdings/shareholding percentages, domestic institutional investor data, current five-session flows, EPS or P/E targets are established by these reports.
No imported records, runtime consumers, Mongo coverage, current universe or live signals are claimed. Cross-file candidate collisions are not authorization to drop reports.
interpretation: Four 19-column historical transaction CSV reports fully parsed. Dates are explicitly day/month/year for Mar_2021.csv and ISO year-month-day for 2023 members; the same archive family must not impose one ambiguous date parser.
Hypothetical rounding bounds diagnose compatibility only, not provider rounding policy, settlement charges, correction semantics or transaction validity.
Candidate keys and duplicate rows need authoritative correction/deduplication semantics before adoption. Identifiers and transaction codes retain leading zeros and case.
All public values are aggregates or bounded numeric/date exception locators; no investor/broker/transaction identifiers or security names are disclosed.

audit_script.database_role: Disposable local audit counters only, not application MongoDB.
audit_script.execution_note: Every source byte and CSV field freshly reparsed. Full exact-key counter database from the prior completed all-record pass reused read-only and its row accounting rechecked.
